description: Prepare a project inquiry for review before submission to The2410. Run plan-project-tool first and provide the existing project_context_id. The customer's name and email are required on every call; company and phone are optional. Return the saved project fit, offering, estimate and modules with their price and effort. Delivery dates are indicative; if not calculated, the response explains how to request them. This tool does not submit the inquiry or send an email.

comments.description: Inquiry comments. Replaces saved comments. Omit to keep them; null clears them.

contact.description: Customer contact details. Name and email are required; company and phone are optional.

project_context_id.description: The exact project context UUID returned by a previous tool call.

name: prepare-project-inquiry-tool
title: Prepare project inquiry
